briefdescription.para: Abstract Ring subclass that lifts either a FreeAlgebra or a FreeAlgebraQuotient into the engine's Ring hierarchy.

detaileddescription.para: The common base of M2FreeAlgebra (the unquotiented case) and M2FreeAlgebraQuotient. Provides the Ring overrides that dispatch to the underlying freeAlgebra() and the type-safe cast helpers (toPoly / fromPoly / appendFromModuleMonom) the rest of the engine uses to convert between opaque ring_elem handles and concrete Poly* values.
